name: process_step_integration
label: Integration Table for Process Step References
description: The integration table for process steps is used for querying, filtering, and presenting data related to the process.

fields.name: process_step_uuid
fields.description: The unique identifier for the step, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: integration_uuid
fields.description: Integration configuration UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the process_step_uuid, integration_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_integration_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the integration_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
